 The Lakers are favored at home on Sunday, but can they cover? Peter Dewey | Share on Facebook Share on X Add us as a preferred source Toronto Raptors forward Scottie Barnes is a solid prop target on Sunday. | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect In this story:
 Los Angeles Lakers Toronto Raptors Sunday’s four-game slate in the NBA closes out with two potential playoff teams facing off, as the Los Angeles Lakers and Luka Doncic host the Toronto Raptors.
--> Sunday’s four-game slate in the NBA closes out with two potential playoff teams facing off, as the Los Angeles Lakers and Luka Doncic host the Toronto Raptors.
 Toronto got off to a strong start this season, winning back-to-back games, but Kawhi Leonard (knee) is expected to be sidelined for the next several weeks and has not played since Game 2 of the season. Toronto is 1-2 since, including a loss in the NBA Cup on Friday against the Orlando Magic.
--> Toronto got off to a strong start this season, winning back-to-back games, but Kawhi Leonard (knee) is expected to be sidelined for the next several weeks and has not played since Game 2 of the season. Toronto is 1-2 since, including a loss in the NBA Cup on Friday against the Orlando Magic.
 So, it makes sense that Scottie Barnes and Co. are underdogs on the road against Doncic and the 4-2 Lakers. L.A. lost in the NBA Cup as well on Friday, falling to Golden State, but it’s still gotten off to a strong start in the 2026-27 season, ranking second in the league in offensive rating and ninth in net rating.
--> So, it makes sense that Scottie Barnes and Co. are underdogs on the road against Doncic and the 4-2 Lakers. L.A. lost in the NBA Cup as well on Friday, falling to Golden State, but it’s still gotten off to a strong start in the 2026-27 season, ranking second in the league in offensive rating and ninth in net rating.
 J.J. Redick’s group has a tough test against the No. 2 defense in the league in Toronto, and the Lakers are just 1-2 against the spread at home, covering only in their home opener against Golden State.
--> J.J. Redick’s group has a tough test against the No. 2 defense in the league in Toronto, and the Lakers are just 1-2 against the spread at home, covering only in their home opener against Golden State.
 Does that change on Sunday with Doncic, Austin Reaves and Walker Kessler all expected to play?

 This season, Scottie Barnes is averaging 24.0 points, 6.8 rebounds and 4.4 assists per game while shooting 46.3 percent from the field and just 16.7 percent from 3. Barnes has never been an elite 3-point shooter, but he has seen his offensive role expand with Kawhi Leonard (knee) sidelined. 
--> This season, Scottie Barnes is averaging 24.0 points, 6.8 rebounds and 4.4 assists per game while shooting 46.3 percent from the field and just 16.7 percent from 3. Barnes has never been an elite 3-point shooter, but he has seen his offensive role expand with Kawhi Leonard (knee) sidelined. 
 Barnes has scored 41 and 28 points in his last two games, taking 34 and 17 shots in those games. After a dreadful 0-for-12 shooting night in this first game without Leonard (Barnes did not score in that game), the All-Star forward has rebounded and been a true go-to option for Toronto. 
--> Barnes has scored 41 and 28 points in his last two games, taking 34 and 17 shots in those games. After a dreadful 0-for-12 shooting night in this first game without Leonard (Barnes did not score in that game), the All-Star forward has rebounded and been a true go-to option for Toronto. 
 In fact, it’s pretty shocking Barnes is averaging 24.0 points per game even with a scoreless appearance, as he’s cleared 23.5 points in three of his five games, scoring at least 23 points in four of five matchups.

 Now, he takes on a Los Angeles team that is 19th in the NBA in defensive rating and really lacks elite wing talent. There are some good wing defenders for the Lakers (Jarred Vanderbilt, Matisse Thybulle, Ziaire Williams), but Barnes could be a tough matchup for this team as a whole, especially when Walker Kessler isn’t protecting the rim.

 After a 34-shot showing on Friday, Barnes (21.6 shots per game), has a sky-high floor when it comes to this prop.

 Raptors vs. Lakers Prediction and Pick 
--> Raptors vs. Lakers Prediction and Pick 
 These are two different teams, as the Lakers (No. 2 in offense) and Raptors (No. 2 in defense) win in very different ways.
--> These are two different teams, as the Lakers (No. 2 in offense) and Raptors (No. 2 in defense) win in very different ways.
 Toronto still has the No. 10 offense this season, but it’s clear the team isn’t as dominant on that end without the threat of Leonard as an isolation scorer on the wing. The Raptors have still covered the spread in three of their five games, and they may be undervalued a bit on the road.
--> Toronto still has the No. 10 offense this season, but it’s clear the team isn’t as dominant on that end without the threat of Leonard as an isolation scorer on the wing. The Raptors have still covered the spread in three of their five games, and they may be undervalued a bit on the road.
 While the Lakers are off to a strong 4-2 start, they’ve covered the spread just once at home and are 19th in the league in defense. L.A. has played Golden State twice, the Clippers twice, Utah and Portland to begin the 2026-27 campaign, losing games to the Warriors and Blazers. Both of those teams are in the play-in conversation in the West, while Toronto was sixth in the odds to win the title before Leonard went down.
--> While the Lakers are off to a strong 4-2 start, they’ve covered the spread just once at home and are 19th in the league in defense. L.A. has played Golden State twice, the Clippers twice, Utah and Portland to begin the 2026-27 campaign, losing games to the Warriors and Blazers. Both of those teams are in the play-in conversation in the West, while Toronto was sixth in the odds to win the title before Leonard went down.
 The Raptors still have plenty of capable scorers – Barnes, Jr Barrett, Immanuel Quickley – on offense, and they have the wing defenders to match up nicely with Doncic and Reaves. 
--> The Raptors still have plenty of capable scorers – Barnes, Jr Barrett, Immanuel Quickley – on offense, and they have the wing defenders to match up nicely with Doncic and Reaves. 
 I don’t mind taking the points here, as this may be the toughest matchup of the season to date for L.A.  
--> I don’t mind taking the points here, as this may be the toughest matchup of the season to date for L.A.
